title: The Point of No Return
narration: At every black hole's heart, space ends. Escape velocity exceeds light's speed. Nothing returns. How do we know they exist?
visual_goal: Ultra-close render of event horizon, light bending into dark void.

title: The Cosmic Echo
narration: In 2015, LIGO heard two black holes merge, confirming binaries. Over 90 mergers since.
visual_goal: Two spheres spiral, collide, ripples in dark fabric.

title: The Shadow of a Giant
narration: In 2019, we imaged M87*—6.5 billion solar masses, 55 million light-years away. First direct silhouette.
visual_goal: Fade to iconic EHT orange ring with dark center.

title: The Lightest Touch
narration: Hawking (1974): black holes leak radiation. Solar-mass hole glows at 0.00000006 K—a whisper. They end in a flicker.
visual_goal: Small black hole, faint particles escaping and dimming.

title: The Hidden Core
narration: Space ends in our backyard: Sagittarius A*, 4.15 million solar masses at the Milky Way's center. It's home.
visual_goal: Pan from Sagittarius A* to Milky Way galaxy zoom-out.

sfx_events.trigger: low orchestral swell ending on a deep note
